    • selectOwnedInputs

      public static List<UtxoSnapshot> selectOwnedInputs(List<UtxoSnapshot> available, List<Outpoint> requested)
      Selects only live inputs. A partially valid client selection is rejected rather than silently reduced, which prevents signing a different transaction than the user approved.
      Parameters:
      available - current live outputs associated with the wallet
      requested - optional explicit user-selected inputs
      Returns:
      immutable, deduplicated selection in deterministic observation/request order
      Throws:
      WalletRuleViolation - when no outputs exist or a requested output is not owned and live
